about.text: Sana is a slightly sweet Romanian drinkable fermented milk, at least 3.6% fat, similar to kefir and buttermilk, which bakers also use in breads and pastries. It is made from raw milk, and has been part of the national diet for centuries.

sources.text: The origin, raw milk, fat content and milk sources from the Sana article, and the drinkable yoghurt from the cuisine article.
